question: Within 80 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant ahead of House Of Sports, Ardsley, NY toward Post University, Waterbury, CT?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%House Of Sports%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Ardsley%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Post University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Waterbury%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1 ), route_bearing AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geometry, end_point.geometry)) AS bearing FROM start_point, end_point ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, P.addr_state FROM pois AS P, start_point, end_point, route_bearing WHERE P.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( P.geometry::geography, start_point.geometry::geography, 80000 -- 80 kilometers ) AND ( -- Filter by direction: within +/- 45 degrees of the bearing from start to end point ABS( degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geometry, P.geometry)) - route_bearing.bearing ) < 45 OR ABS( degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geometry, P.geometry)) - route_bearing.bearing ) > 360 - 45 -- Handles wrap-around for angles (e.g., 350 vs 10 degrees) ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, start_point.geometry::geography) ASC;
